entries.zh: 对所承诺之事起誓；盟誓立约
entries.en: to swear to what one has promised; to take a covenant oath
entries.notes: L 末段 'la candel sangze' 漫漶，M 六音节与 H 二字不合，H 栏疑仅存首二字，释义取 盟誓 本义。

entries.en: to swear an oath with an imprecation; to curse in swearing
to swear; to vow with an oath
to make a vow (to a deity)
to swear; to take an oath
to swear a covenant; to take a mutual oath
a written oath; an oath document
entries.notes: L 末段 'la candel sangze' 漫漶不可解，H 誓章 与 M sī-chiang 相合，据以定。

entries.en: to swear by smearing or drinking blood; a blood oath
entries.notes: H 栏两处存疑，L 'befriend…fura mto' 漫漶，M chap-hūē 与 歃血 相合，取血誓义。
M 栏混入非闽南语文字（'extrait de la le'），疑串行污损，仅据 L/H 推断。
M 'fing' 与 H 屬 音不合，另标 T99，音写不足据。

entries.en: within the territory; the territory under jurisdiction
territorial bounds; the borders of a jurisdiction

entries.zh: 宰治；执掌刑政（次义：宰杀）
entries.en: to govern or administer (justice); also to slaughter
entries.notes: L 'Justicia distribución' 疑为 distributiva 或司法之分派，H 单字 宰，义取主掌。

entries.en: to kill; to put to death
heavenly principle; natural justice; conscience and reason

entries.zh: 剑戟施威（喻严刑峻法、以威刑执治）
entries.en: displaying the might of sword and halberd; harsh or rigorous justice
entries.notes: H 四字三处存疑，M 末音节 mūi 与 威 不合，仅据 L 'Justicia rigorosa' 定'严酷执法'。
L 云'战时所用之习俗'与 H 鄉俗 不合，音写 hiàng-sio̍k 合 鄉俗，暂从 H。
M 首音 quîn=均 与 H/L 相合，后半句标 T99 漫漶不可读。
